jobs.title: Investment Banking Associate - Capital Advisory
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Solomon is a leading investment bank – one of the first independent firms in the industry. Our difference is creating long-term shareholder value through our unmatched industry expertise and decades of experience.

With capabilities across M&A, capital advisory and restructuring, Solomon offers industry knowledge, understanding and access across 12+ core sectors. Working with corporations, founders, private equity sponsors, venture capital investors, and hedge funds, our bankers are fully invested in their client relationships, supporting their goals and objectives.

At Solomon, we’re industry experts, great bankers and good people who care deeply about our clients. We provide our employees with the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on our business, advance and develop their careers, and contribute to our culture of growth, collaboration, and entrepreneurship.

To learn more about Solomon Partners, visit  www.solomonpartners.com .
